datasets.name: carddemo
datasets.role: Enterprise mainframe flagship: CICS online (BMS, pseudo-conversational XCTL, CSD), VSAM batch driven by JCL/PROCs, DB2/IMS/MQ extensions. Main wiki + leaf-doc benchmark; batch programs and CSUTLDTC are executable under GnuCOBOL.

datasets.name: genapp
datasets.role: IBM CICS General Insurance Application: layered CICS LINK architecture (front end -> business logic -> DB2/VSAM data tiers), JCL for DB2/CICS setup. Wiki layering benchmark; tests are spec-mode (CICS/DB2).

datasets.name: cbi
datasets.role: Human-written GnuCOBOL BASIC interpreter: fixed format, 37/37 units compile, pure LINKAGE subprograms, FUNCTION-ID / ENTRY / RECURSIVE / LOCAL-STORAGE. Executable unit-test benchmark (fetched at a pinned commit, never vendored).

optional.name: kofbank
optional.note: large GnuCOBOL core-banking system; used only as a scale test, not as representative legacy code
